Source Sans 3 variable upright font, distributed without modification.

Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans
File: WOFF2/VF/SourceSans3VF-Upright.ttf.woff2 (release branch)
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt.

The font is self-hosted so documentation does not need an external font service.
